strings.en: Hey... Nadesi... can y... hear me?
Huh? Did you hear something just now?
Heeey.
I definitely hear it.
A ghost?
Heeey. Can you all hear me?
Akito!?
Where are you now, Akito?
Umm, I'm in Von Braun.
What about Banjo?
I'm with Tenkawa.
Though we caused a bit of a stir in town...
Master Banjo, I am delighted to see you safe.
Like how we came to the Hyakki island on Dr. Tarsan's warp beam...
they went from here to the moon in an instant?
But there wasn't any special device, was there?
I wonder if that sparkly stone had something to do with it?
So what, then? Like when we fell into Ilbora's trap and teleported,
they went to the moon in an instant?
Without a Teleport Machine?
That's what it comes down to, right?
It's Tenkawa's power...
He could do something like that?
And thanks to the CC...
Um, uh... Where's Yurika?
The Captain has been shut away in the observation room for a while now.
Akito, hurry and let the Captain see you're all right.
We'll need to sort out the information. Anyway, I'm glad you're safe.
Akitooo...
Yurika... Are you crying?
......A ghost?
I said no.
How? Is it really you? Where are you now?
I'm not really sure... The moon.
Okay, I'm coming right now!
Idiot, you can't just come on your own...
I said I'm coming, so I'm coming!
The Nadesico's a warship now, you know.
Ugh...
Captain... please come to the bridge at once. Admiral Misumaru is calling.
Huh? Father is?
What on earth!? Anyone would normally notice something like that!?
It seems it was just a meteor swarm at first, but it absorbed surrounding
matter and grew rapidly.
It's set a course for Earth.
If something with that much mass were to hit Earth...
The cost of the damage would be considerable...
I'd rather not think about it.
And just when we're about to go back into Jaburo...
But we can't just leave something like this alone, can we?
We're considering destroying it with the colony laser,
but we won't know whether Gryps II works properly until we get there.
That thing can't be relied on!
We must also think about what to do if Gryps II can't be used.
Sorry, sorry! I'm late!
Ah, Yurika.
Eww!? Wh-What's this creepy image!?
It's what was at PLS Black Point.
Huh? That turned into THIS!?
Yes, and it seems to be approaching Earth...
No way... What do you intend to do, Father?
We're working out countermeasures now.
To continue what I was saying, if the attack with Gryps II fails,
I believe our only option is to storm the inside of the plant planet.
Mm. Indeed, that may be all we can do...
So Londo Bell is our lifeline, then.
I'm sorry, Bright. Right now, all we can do is rely on you...
Not at all. Londo Bell's strength has grown, too,
with Dancougar, Raideen, and others.
How about this?
You have a good idea, Yurika?
We leave retaking Jaburo to the Gandor Team,
and the Nadesico goes up to space too and joins Londo Bell.
Things are rough down here too, but if the plant planet hits,
retaking Jaburo won't even matter anymore...
Yes. Right now, it may be wiser to send forces into space
to stop the plant planet.
That's my Yurika.
I am your daughter, after all.
Bright, where would be best to rendezvous with the Nadesico?
I think the moon would be a good rendezvous point.
Indeed, Captain. How about meeting at Nergal's lunar dock?
Good idea. That's close to Von Braun, where Akito is...
Akito...?
Oh, just talking to myself!
There we can also fully resupply all of you in Londo Bell.
Thank you very much. We'll be waiting on the moon, then.
(Yes! Now I've got an excuse to go pick up Akito!)
...That concludes the briefing. Now that the Nadesico has left for space,
we'll be storming Jaburo on our own...
The problem is... the Neo Zeon unit that landed east of Jaburo.
Who'd have thought they'd strike right after we stopped the colony...
Haman Karn, huh... A shrewd woman.
With that timing, even Bright and the others could only watch
them descend.
This is no time to be praising her.
Right now... Jaburo is surrounded on all four sides, you know?
The west side was the Titans' mobile suit unit with ties to Zeon, right?
And to the north...
Survivors of Zeon's ground forces...! Where'd they find the strength...!
Brother...
Aina... do you know anything?
...No, my brother didn't... tell me anything...
Zeon on three sides, and on the south side...
I saw the data. ...No mistake. Those are Hyakki and Campbellian robots.
And... quite a lot of 'em, too.
I thought it was finally over... What's going on!?
In short... it ain't over. Dammit all!
And the Hyakki Empire... we beat them right before our eyes...!
Could they have kept some forces in reserve?
That's hard to believe. That was an all-out war, any way you look at it.
Besides... even if the Hyakki and the Campbellians aren't wiped out yet...
I can't see those two armies joining hands.
Yes. The southern forces are all marching north toward Jaburo.
All of them are AI-controlled robots. That part bothers me a little...
Maybe we shouldn't have sent the Nadesico into space?
But stopping the plant planet comes before retaking Jaburo.
No use talking about it. We just do our job.
...There's just one thing we do know.
...They're all... headed for Jaburo...!
Guess we've... got no choice but to go.
This is nuts. Enemies north, south, east, and west. It's the end times.
But even if we force our way into Jaburo...
The enemy will hit us from every direction... If we push into Jaburo...
the enemies who catch up will have us pinned in between...!
So we'll just have to crush them one at a time.
...All right, everyone, return to your stations.
The Gandor will now launch the operation to take Jaburo...!
